records.target: Iran and Gulf conflict-wide damage proxy
records.sensor_provider: Copernicus Sentinel-1 SAR via Bellingcat PWTT
records.visible_finding: Statistical structural-change proxy over Iran and Gulf; useful for triage, not definitive BDA.
records.redistribution: Underlying Sentinel data is open; Bellingcat rendered graphics remain link-only unless separately licensed.

records.attribution: US_ISRAEL_COMBINED_CAMPAIGN; strike-level attribution unresolved in this add-on
records.visible_finding: Bellingcat reports clear indications of structural damage in Sentinel-2, with matching Sentinel-1 change signal.
records.redistribution: Retrieve original Sentinel scenes from Copernicus for redistributable derivatives.

records.visible_finding: Large damage/change signature corroborated in open optical imagery.
records.redistribution: Use coordinate as complex reference only; confirm against EO scene before publishing a pin.

records.visible_finding: Damage to multiple large buildings on north side of base.
records.redistribution: Retrieve Sentinel imagery; airfield coordinate is not an impact coordinate.

records.visible_finding: Large damage clusters on eastern and western sides near reported propellant-production areas.
records.damage_confidence: HIGH_FOR_LARGE_CHANGE; function-specific loss requires separate BDA
records.redistribution: Reference point locates the complex, not a specific 2026 impact.

records.visible_finding: Large blackened area on warehouse roof at the same point as damage-proxy signal.
records.redistribution: Open Sentinel scenes may be republished with attribution; do not generalize warehouse damage to whole-base incapacity.

records.target: Qasem Soleimani / Ahvaz International Airport aircraft parking area
records.sensor_provider: CENTCOM strike video + public satellite/geolocation comparison
records.visible_finding: F-5/F-27 aircraft destruction geolocated to this point; runway cratered by March 5. Operational status of every parked airframe is not established.
records.redistribution: CENTCOM footage public; third-party/commercial satellite imagery link-only unless separately licensed.

records.target: Bandar Abbas naval base — Kilo submarine berth
records.sensor_provider: Planet commercial imagery reviewed by TWZ + U.S. official strike statements
records.visible_finding: One Kilo-class submarine visible/untouched March 2 and assessed sunk by March 4; U.S. leadership stated an ATACMS sank a submarine.
records.redistribution: Do not copy Planet imagery; link source. Use open Sentinel/Umbra scenes for independent broad corroboration if available.

records.target: Bandar Abbas submarine/maintenance dock — July 12 Corsair strike
records.visible_finding: Three U.S. lethal unmanned surface vessels attacked a submarine-port/maintenance facility; exact damage extent requires post-strike imagery.
records.redistribution: Official video can be linked/embedded subject to U.S. government media terms; coordinate from third-party geolocation should be labeled accordingly.

note: Coordinates distinguish impact points from facility/reference points. A coordinate is not proof of damage.
